projects.title: Pushrod Core MVP
projects.description: Pushrod's MVP: v0.1 (dialog applications) and v0.2 (forms and resources).
projects.readme: Every issue in Pushrod's MVP, in work order. Group by **Phase** (v0.1, v0.2) and sort by **Order**. Roadmap: docs/ROADMAP_EXTENSIBLE_WIDGET_LIBRARY.md.

items.title: pushrod: [1] Epic: Core: behavior flags, focus, timing, and performance
pushrod: [3] Epic: Value and choice controls
pushrod: [4] Epic: Lists, tables, progress, spin boxes, and tabs
pushrod: [5] Epic: Composition, clipping, and layout managers
pushrod: [6] Epic: Forms and form files (foundation for Chassis)
pushrod: [7] Epic: Quality, documentation, and release
pushrod: [9] Epic: Event model and callbacks
pushrod: [10] Epic: Rendering backends, drawing modes, and vintage hardware
pushrod: [1.21] Split the standard widgets into the pushrod-widgets crate
pushrod: [7.1] CI: build, test, clippy, fmt, doc with SDL2
pushrod: [7.8] Documentation site: build pushrod-docs in CI and publish it
pushrod: [9.1] Event vocabulary: modern event names and structure
pushrod: [10.2] Backend-neutral paint API (SDL2 backend by default)
pushrod: [1.1] Widget behavior flags and visual states
pushrod: [1.2] Event masks for the run loop and for widgets
pushrod: [9.10] Engine events: every internal action Pushrod performs emits an event
pushrod: [9.11] Event-loop style: keep parity with callbacks
pushrod: [1.3] Broadcast events to all interested widgets
pushrod: [1.6] Callback registry for every widget event
pushrod: [1.13] Custom application events with payloads
pushrod: [1.18] Text layout engine: Parley for shaping, bidi, line breaking, and font fallback (with an SDL2 compatibility gate)
pushrod: [1.7] GPU text: font cache with a glyph atlas texture
pushrod: [7.6] Module boundaries and written specs with conformance tests
pushrod: [9.2] Event propagation: capture, target, and bubble phases with handled/ignored
pushrod: [9.4] Reusable input controllers: click, drag, scroll, hover, long-press, key
pushrod: [1.4] Keyboard focus, Tab order, and Return/Escape
pushrod: [1.19] Input method (IME) support: composition text and candidate window
pushrod: [1.17] Per-state appearance: colors, border, and font for each visual state
pushrod: [1.26] Text truncation: shorten text that doesn't fit with an ellipsis
pushrod: [1.27] Wrapped text: multi-line labels that reflow
pushrod: [1.12] Keyboard mnemonics: underlined shortcut letters
pushrod: [10.6] Backend crates: keep SDL out of the core and the widgets
pushrod: [1.25] Errors: return Result instead of panicking
pushrod: [1.24] Fonts: shared font handles and a built-in default font
pushrod: [1.23] Public API polish before publishing: builders, prelude, and stability
pushrod: [2.3] Button behaviors: default, cancel, toggle, activate-on-press, dismiss dialog
pushrod: [2.4] Check box with indeterminate state
pushrod: [2.5] Radio buttons and radio groups
pushrod: [2.6] Text field: single-line entry with input masks, validation, and numeric mode
pushrod: [5.1] Clip children to their parent's bounds
pushrod: [5.2] Composite widgets: build widgets from parts that applications can retrieve and modify
pushrod: [5.5] Layout manager foundation: Layout trait, size hints, measure and arrange
pushrod: [5.7] Form layout: aligned label and field rows
pushrod: [5.3] Container: a scrollable viewport onto fixed-size content
pushrod: [1.10] High-DPI rendering and window resize
pushrod: [7.9] Easy installation: bundled SDL, static linking, and platform guides
pushrod: [6.2] Property introspection: list, get, and set widget properties by name
pushrod: [1.14] Accessibility: expose widgets to screen readers
pushrod: [6.4] Form loader: build a form from a file with stable IDs
pushrod: [6.5] Form writer: save a widget subtree to a file
pushrod: [6.6] Generate ID constants from a form file
pushrod: [6.11] Resource kinds: strings, images, icons, files, menus, and alerts
pushrod: [6.12] Typed resource IDs: generated constants per resource kind
pushrod: [6.10] Resource manager: load resource sets and get resources by ID
pushrod: [1.8] Edit the widget tree at run time: remove, reparent, reorder
pushrod: [6.7] Modal dialogs: run a form until a dismissing control is chosen
pushrod: [7.10] Reference application: a real app built only with Pushrod
pushrod: [7.4] Guide: writing widgets and composites
pushrod: [7.5] Changelog, Cargo metadata, and crates.io release

projects.title: Pushrod Showcase
projects.description: The interactive demo of every widget and core feature, built right after the Pushrod MVP.
projects.readme: One application showing every widget live, with a property panel, event log, and source view. Needs only MVP features. Every later widget adds its page. Roadmap: docs/ROADMAP_EXTENSIBLE_WIDGET_LIBRARY.md, Epic 12.

items.title: pushrod: [12] Epic: Pushrod Showcase: an interactive demo of every widget
pushrod: [12.2] Showcase pages for every standard widget, with a completeness test
pushrod: [12.3] Showcase property panel: change any property live
pushrod: [12.5] Showcase source view: the code for each page
pushrod: [12.6] Showcase pages for core features: text, layouts, focus, dialogs, forms, and resources
pushrod: [12.7] Showcase in CI: scripted tour, golden screenshots, and documentation images

projects.title: Chassis MVP
projects.description: The Chassis MVP (phases M1 to M5) and the post-MVP Pushrod work it depends on.
projects.readme: Builds on the Pushrod Core MVP project. Each "Pushrod for Mx" phase holds the post-MVP Pushrod issues that Chassis phase Mx needs (directly or indirectly), and each "Extra widgets for Mx" phase the pushrod-extra-widgets issues it needs; they come before it in **Order**. Roadmap: docs/ROADMAP_CHASSIS.md (Action Plan).

projects.title: Extra Widgets
projects.description: The pushrod-extra-widgets crate: larger and compound widgets outside the Pushrod MVP.
projects.readme: Everything in pushrod-extra-widgets not already in the Chassis MVP project (the crate, tool palette, property grid, breadcrumb bar, and drawer are there), with the post-MVP Pushrod work it needs first. Milestones 1 and 2 are the extra-widgets MVP. Roadmap: docs/ROADMAP_EXTRA_WIDGETS.md.

Extra widgets 2 - everyday controls and pickers
